title: Approve all approves one group under the press's rules with the agreed skips, and the send queue sends one approved email per pass under the same checks, pausing on anything that may concern every email
steps: Run the content and send ledger suites against a private PostgreSQL (TEST_DATABASE_URL) with fake Google and fake aMember, and the mounted harness flow suite, from this branch.
expect: Approve all on a group skips exactly one suppressed, one hand-edited and one no-plan customer, approves the rest, and a second pass approves nothing and counts them as already approved.

The queue makes one messages.send per pass; a customer with no plan is skipped as REAL_NOT_MEMBER; pause stops sending and resume continues; pacing holds a pass; an unknown outcome pauses with SEND_UNKNOWN and no second send; sending off pauses with REAL_PILOT_OFF; the finished queue reads done with 2 sent and 1 skipped; no stored queue row contains an address.
The Send tab queue card and Review content Approve all each need a second press, and Approve all loops pages for the chosen group only.
fence: Fake Google and fake aMember only; no credential, no real mailbox, no customer address.

tests: Approve all approves a group page by page, skipping suppressed, hand-edited and no-plan customers
send queue: sends approved emails one per pass under the same checks, skips a customer refusal, pauses on unknown
Send all approved asks once more, starts the server queue, and shows pause and resume
Approve all works on the chosen group only, asks once more, and loops pages until done
